Earlier this year, Twelve South launched the all-new Valet accessory, which they described as a "wireless charging stand and personal belongings tray."

Now, Twelve South has expanded the Valet lineup, adding a smaller option equipped with MagSafe and Qi2.2 wireless charging, supporting up to 25W charging power.

The first-generation Valet announced earlier this year measures 7.5 inches, offering enough space to hold items like a phone, keys, wallet, and glasses. However, the new version of Valet has been significantly downsized to 4.25 inches.

Here is Twelve South's description of the Valet's premium design:

The design philosophy of Valet is to first create an aesthetically pleasing home accessory, then a precise wireless charger. It blends warm materials with modern precision craftsmanship, creating a calmer, more thoughtful form that fits seamlessly anywhere in the home—from the entryway table and kitchen to the bedside table. The soft square charging pad echoes the architectural lines of the leather tray. At the same time, the weighted zinc alloy base keeps everything stable and tidy at all times.

In terms of functionality, the smaller Valet's charging capability is more than sufficient and can easily charge your iPhone. It also features a built-in additional USB-C port for conveniently charging another accessory at the same time:

  • Qi2.2 wireless charging up to 25W
  • Premium Nappa leather storage tray
  • Four adjustable orientation options
  • Replaceable leather bezel
  • Weighted zinc alloy base with concealed cable management
  • Additional USB-C port supporting up to 10W wired charging
  • Includes a 45W power adapter and a 1.5-meter USB-C cable

The 4.25-inch Twelve South Valet is available for pre-order starting today, priced at $129.99, available in three different color combinations. It's not cheap, but it's a quite stylish spot where you can put down your phone to charge while also holding your glasses, wallet, or keys.
